Name: Clint Hair Fix (sprite recolor)
Author: scrptrx
Description:
[center][size=1][b]WARNING:[/b] Do not download this mod from any place other than NexusMods or the Chucklefish forums! 
WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. 
[b]DO NOT download any mods there! [/b]If you see my mods anywhere other than Nexus or the forums, please link me to the site asap. Thank you![/size]

. . . . . .[/center]

I barely even started to play this game when I fell hard for Clint, the unavailable blacksmith. Luckily, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366/?]Siv's Marriage Mod[/url] exists, and all was well. 
Except for Clint's sprite. 

Clint's default sprite bothered me. It really did. His hair looks like a bowl cut that he has had since he was a kid. His default profile pic, however, is quite different, with the hint of curls and natural light-brown highlights. 
So I fixed it.
[b]
[u]This mod is a simple recolor of Clint's hair, goatee, and a tiny apron pocket fix[/u]. [/b]Clint's sprite, from all angles, now looks like he has highlights and waves/curls, and his pocket no longer looks like a big old boob from some angles. The goatee is a LITTLE bit more auburn. I also tried to make it so he didn't always look perplexed or angry. 

Users should note that I initially made this mod with [b]Siv's Marriage Mod 1.1.0[/b] in mind, using that modded file as a base ([i]this includes the weird geode processing glitch!!)[/i]. I later tweaked it to resemble the vanilla sprite sheet. I have NOT tested the vanilla game file, but it should work. If it does not, please let me know, and I'll fix it if I can.

This is my first ever mod. Ever. The help files at [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/old-post-in-new-thread-mod-list-modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion.106868/]PlayStarBound [/url]helped a lot. 

Credit goes to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33868135/?]sivolobwho[/url] for the added Clint animations and sprite sheet. Modded with permission.

[u]Instructions[/u][b]:[/b]
Copy Clint.xnb into /Stardew Valley/Content/Characters and PLEASE backup your original game files before hand!
